changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Informe de verificacion de integridad del historico (REQ-152): cabecera de cada ejecucion, inmutable y sin descripcion de incidencia
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE integridad_informe ( integrity_report_id NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, executed_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, executed_by NUMBER, scope_date_from DATE, scope_date_to DATE, checked_count NUMBER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, inconsistency_count NUMBER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, status VARCHAR2(20 CHAR) DEFAULT 'EN_CURSO' NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_integridad_informe PRIMARY KEY (integrity_report_id), CONSTRAINT fk_integridad_informe_ejecutor FOREIGN KEY (executed_by) REFERENCES usuario (user_id) )

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Reglas de coherencia del informe de integridad (REQ-152): enumerado de estado, rango de fechas ordenado y ventana maxima de 24 meses
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE integridad_informe ADD CONSTRAINT ck_integridad_informe_status CHECK (status IN ('EN_CURSO','COMPLETADO','FALLIDO'))
ALTER TABLE integridad_informe ADD CONSTRAINT ck_integridad_informe_rango CHECK (scope_date_from IS NULL OR scope_date_to IS NULL OR scope_date_from <= scope_date_to)
ALTER TABLE integridad_informe ADD CONSTRAINT ck_integridad_informe_ventana CHECK (scope_date_from IS NULL OR scope_date_to IS NULL OR MONTHS_BETWEEN(scope_date_to, scope_date_from) <= 24)
ALTER TABLE integridad_informe ADD CONSTRAINT ck_integridad_informe_checked CHECK (checked_count >= 0)
ALTER TABLE integridad_informe ADD CONSTRAINT ck_integridad_informe_hallazgos CHECK (inconsistency_count >= 0)

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE integridad_informe DROP CONSTRAINT ck_integridad_informe_hallazgos
ALTER TABLE integridad_informe DROP CONSTRAINT ck_integridad_informe_checked
ALTER TABLE integridad_informe DROP CONSTRAINT ck_integridad_informe_ventana
ALTER TABLE integridad_informe DROP CONSTRAINT ck_integridad_informe_rango
ALTER TABLE integridad_informe DROP CONSTRAINT ck_integridad_informe_status

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Hallazgo de un informe de integridad (REQ-152): incidencia afectada y regla incumplida, nunca su descripcion
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE integridad_hallazgo ( finding_id NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, integrity_report_id NUMBER NOT NULL, incident_id NUMBER NOT NULL, rule_code VARCHAR2(30 CHAR) NOT NULL, finding_detail VARCHAR2(500 CHAR), CONSTRAINT pk_integridad_hallazgo PRIMARY KEY (finding_id), CONSTRAINT ck_integridad_hallazgo_rule CHECK (rule_code IN ('sin_alta','secuencia_rota','estado_desalineado','hash_alterado')), CONSTRAINT fk_integridad_hallazgo_informe FOREIGN KEY (integrity_report_id) REFERENCES integridad_informe (integrity_report_id), CONSTRAINT fk_integridad_hallazgo_incidencia FOREIGN KEY (incident_id) REFERENCES incidencia (incident_id) )

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Indices de consulta del informe de integridad y cerrojo de ejecucion unica (AC-HIST-07)
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_integridad_informe_executed_at ON integridad_informe (executed_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_integridad_informe_en_curso ON integridad_informe (CASE WHEN status = 'EN_CURSO' THEN 1 END)
